plugin.name: Commerce USDT
plugin.description: USDT (ERC-20) payment gateway for GoPress Commerce. Pull-based confirmation uses a unique HD-derived address per order, verified Ethereum RPC data, atomic scan cursors, chain-time expiry, and idempotent settlement. The implementation is EVM-extensible; Ethereum is currently supported.
plugin.settings.title: %s - Plugin Settings
plugin.usdt.settings.payment_help: When enabled and fully configured, USDT appears among the checkout payment methods.
plugin.usdt.settings.rpc_help: A read-only JSON-RPC endpoint (self-hosted or trusted). Chain ID, contract code, and token decimals are verified on save and before every scan.
plugin.usdt.settings.contract_help: Mainnet accepts only the built-in canonical USDT contract. On a testnet, provide your test token contract.
plugin.usdt.settings.xpub_help: A watch-only xpub (e.g. m/44'/60'/0'/0) used to derive a unique deposit address per order. The server holds only the public key and has no spend authority.
plugin.usdt.settings.confirmations_help: Blocks required before a payment is considered settled (24 recommended on Ethereum mainnet).
plugin.usdt.settings.rate_help: The rate converting the order total (USD) into the USDT amount due. Default 1.00.
plugin.usdt.settings.dust_help: Allowed USDT shortfall in token minor units. USDT uses 6 decimals; keep this at 0 unless required. It must be lower than every invoice amount.
plugin.usdt.settings.ready: Configuration complete. USDT will appear at checkout.
plugin.usdt.settings.not_ready: Enable USDT and provide a verified RPC URL, contract address, and receiving xpub before it can appear at USD checkout.
